headline: Compressor and heater block higher output

highlights.text: Limits at +0.1%: suction 120% at 120% feed - needs bigger machine
Heater needs 9753 m2 vs 8800 m2 installed at 120% - clean first
Body follows heater: heat balance 100.1% at 120% when fouled
Purge heater tight at 96% at 120% - no change needed but watch

proposals.title: Clean main brine heater to clean performance
proposals.why: Cheapest: restores driving force without new steel; verified area drops from 110.8% to ~89% of 8800 m2 frame.

proposals.title: Add compressor suction capacity to 275 t/h
proposals.why: No operating move unloads suction at fixed 120% boil-up; power 11.3 MW still inside 14 MW motor so larger wheel / parallel unit works.
proposals.unverified_reason: changes a documented limit (limits.K-201.max_kg_h): a rating only changes with a physical modification and its own evidence, so this cannot be verified in the simulator

summary: At 120% feed the vapour compressor reaches 120% of suction capacity and the main heater needs 110.8% of installed area. Cleaning the heater and adding compressor capacity to 275 t/h clears 120% within motor and area limits.
request: Get the unit to 120% of today's throughput. Find every equipment item that limits it and propose the cheapest change for each, verified in DWSIM, within every utility and frame limit on the data sheet.
